text: Quick recap. Asexual reproduction makes clones, sexual reproduction makes variation. Pollination is autogamy, geitonogamy or xenogamy, carried by wind, water, insects, birds or bats. Double fertilization gives a two n zygote and a three n endosperm. The anther wall is epidermis, endothecium, middle layers and tapetum, which feeds the pollen. The embryo sac has seven cells and eight nuclei. The Capsella embryo goes octant, globular, heart, torpedo; the maize embryo has a scutellum. And endosperm is nuclear, cellular or helobial.
